newsitem.title: USA: Late spot U.S. propane steady to lower, trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: Late spot U.S. propane steady to lower, trade quiet.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices were steady to slightly lower in quiet late activity on Monday following a morning of volatility, players said.
"It's very quiet. It's hard to see where propane is going," said one Houston trader.
Spot propane in Mont Belvieu, Texas, held onto a nearly 4.00 cent intraday gain after plunging this morning on forecasts for warm weather later this week.
Final approval by the U.N. to allow Iraqi oil to flow into the market also pushed crude, and therefore propane prices, lower.
In Conway, Kansas, hub sellers stepped down a quarter cent to 80.25 cents but buyers held out at 80.00 cents, players said.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1631
